strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
This much strength on the west side too!?
Where'd they all come crawlin' out from!?
Looks like a lot of them came down during the colony drop chaos.
Yes, but... with numbers like this, they must have prepared in advance.
You mean it was a setup?
Not a setup, so much as... insurance taken out on the colony drop...
would be more accurate. Probably... Haman Karn...!
A different unit from the Titans earlier, huh.
You're here. Gandor.
So many mobile suits still left...
Ghosts of the Titans...!
Why's Zeon usin' Federation robots?
Come to think of it... I remember fighting them a few times.
In the Gryps Conflict... Scirocco was tied up with Haman...
I heard they secretly traded tech and units back then...
Even after the Titans were gone, their cursed legacy
stayed in Zeon's hands...!
Norris, is that true?
...It is as you see, Lady Aina. And... its pilot as well.
Its pilot? What do you mean?
The pilot!? A Titans pilot!?
Who cares how things used to be?
What matters is that the enemy's right in front of us now!
I get what you're saying, Hyoma, but...
Save the debate for later. All units, launch!
Here! So this is where you were... Kamille Bidan!
You're late, Jerid!
What...! Jerid? Jerid Messa!?
This time... this time I'll kill you! Kamille!
What's with this guy? Real charmer. Kamille! You know him?
Hm...? Does he have some issue with Kamille Bidan?
That mobile suit...! Don't tell me it's Scirocco's!?
Kamille, isn't he... a former Titans man!?
Yes. ...Jerid Messa. He used to be with the Titans...
...a man who sided with Paptimus Scirocco...!
Until I beat you... I can't take a single step forward!
You're the wall standing in my way!
Don't give me that!
You can only judge things by who wins or loses a war...!
That's right! That's why I threw everything away to be here!
...Shamelessly piloting a mobile suit like that!
Calm down, Kamille! That war... it's already over!
Kamille, don't get emotional. You'll lose sight of what's in front of you!
Maybe Ilbora felt... the same way, huh, Joe.
Now die! Kamille Bidan!
Jeriiid!
Gaaah! Why! Why can't I win...!
Kamille! Don't you forget... I'll get you!
Ah! He's running away! Show, we have to go after him!
No, Jaburo's surrounded by enemies. Chasing him too far is dangerous.
Besides, that machine was about to blow. Even if he got away...
Besides, with that much damage... I doubt he'll get very far.
If things go badly for him, he may just...
That's right. And we can't spare the forces to chase him, either.
Jerid...!
I'd have liked to finish him off for good.
Guys like that always come back for more.
Kamille, on the battlefield...
...I know, Amuro. But...!
Kamille... poor thing...
Bernie... we turned out all right, didn't we?
Huh? Oh, yeah.
Jerid... why did you have to go as far as joining Zeon just to kill me...?
Bidan... perhaps that man gave himself over
...to an aura of hatred...
Hm, reinforcements?
Just how many of them are down here on Earth!?
Th-that's...!?
...I see. The east side got wiped out, so they came around this way.
Heh, looks like my luck's holding.
Whaaat? It's a Gundam?
Benkei, is that all you've got? ...The scale on that thing is way off.
About twice the size of a Gundam type... Kamille!
Is that... a Gundam!?
That's... the Psycho Gundam...! The Titans' Newtype-only machine!
One giant Gundam, the Devil Gundam, is more than enough!
Ya keep sayin' big, but Combattler's still bigger!
Plus ours has five pilots. Heh, we won't lose!
What's that supposed to mean? More pilots doesn't make you better!
...Dangaioh has four pilots too, you know.
You're both as bad as each other.
Yes...
It was wrecked in the last war, and we restored it.
And for you especially... it must bring back memories, Kamille!
Jerid... you bastard!
...Goodbye, Four...
A direct hit only on the generator...? A gentle way to destroy, Kamille.
Destroying... killing... whether it's gentle or not...
...it doesn't matter, Amuro.
Looks like every enemy in this area has been dealt with.
Though they held us up longer than I expected...
And this right after the colony drop...
...They committed these forces anticipating Stardust would fail.
They probably still have a trump card.
I thought Earth was finally settling down... and now a Zeon onslaught.
But we can't hand Jaburo HQ over to Haman.
Indeed... that's exactly why we came here.
